import sys,random,time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission');from engine import RunEngine
rng=random.Random(8);M=16;E=60000
run={'banks':M,'load_balancers':8,'fifo_bytes':2147483647,'pifo_bytes':2147483647,'refill_batch':32,'sample_period':100000,'borders':[0,10,100,1000],'policy':{'kind':'sff'},'events':[]}
e=RunEngine(run)
expect=[[] for _ in range(M)]; bytesexp=[0]*M
for i in range(E):
 fid=rng.randrange(1000);length=rng.randint(1,100);fs=rng.randrange(5000)
 e.enqueue(i, 2*E-i, fid,length,fs)
 # derive q from log row
 row=e.log[-1];q=row[6];acc=row[7]
 if acc: expect[q].append(2*E-i);bytesexp[q]+=length
# verify cert order via collect
import engine as en
for q in range(M):
 ids=[p.id for p in en.f_collect(e.fifos[q])]
 assert ids==expect[q],(q,len(ids),len(expect[q]))
 assert (e.fifos[q].bytes if e.fifos[q] else 0)==bytesexp[q]
print('60k fifo order/bytes ok',sum(map(len,expect)))
